comment: One predicate, two languages: Go cookies.AuthStatus.Unchecked and utils.js cookieCheckPending. `checked` is the wire key of the cookieStatus / twitchAuthStatus payloads; a row without it is an older binary's payload, which Go cannot produce and JS must read as checked. `badge` is the cookie badge's check state for the row (cookieCheckState in JS; cmd/moombox cookieBadgesFor's tui.CookieStatus in Go, by the names of tui.CookieBadgePrecedence).
